data.name: Ger
data.gender_notes: Ger is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Ger is recorded in name-lists as “Journey, Exile, Stranger”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ger expresses “Journey, Exile, Stranger”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ger total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: גר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: An outsider, a non-Israelite. Used both for those who lived among the Israelites as residents, and for those who were enemies.

in_greek.name: Γερμανός
in_greek.long_meaning: A native or inhabitant of Germania (a region in Europe).

biblical_reference.note: Used frequently in the Old Testament to refer to non-Israelites or foreigners. In some cases, it refers to those who lived among the Israelites as residents (Genesis 12:10, Exodus 22:21, Leviticus 19:33, Numbers 15:14, Deuteronomy 10:19, Joshua 9:3, Ruth 1:4, Nehemiah 13:3, Job 1:3, Psalms 39:13, Proverbs 24:17, Isaiah 2:6, Jeremiah 4:2, Lamentations 1:8, Daniel 11:30), while in other cases it refers to enemies (Genesis 12:10, Exodus 22:21, Leviticus 19:33, Numbers 15:14, Deuteronomy 10:19, Joshua 9:3, Judges 19:3, Ruth 1:4, Nehemiah 11:3, Job 1:3, Psalms 39:13, Proverbs 24:17, Isaiah 2:6, Jeremiah 4:2, Lamentations 1:8, Daniel 11:30, Malachi 1:11).
